Per-loop max 2 open PRs remains a hygiene guideline. Merges strict FIFO oldest-first via the merge-pipeline agent — NEVER merge your own PRs. Claim discipline: verify no other loop JSON / open PR claims a slice before starting. Delete merged slice worktrees after confirming merge.
